subject: Re: FinLytics — APAC dedicated pool sizing and timing
messages:
From: Arya Sharma <arya@finlytics.ai>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: APAC dedicated pool need & timeline

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from the FinLytics infra team — we just closed contract terms internally and have a go-ahead to purchase dedicated inference capacity for our APAC launch. High-level ask: a dedicated pool in APAC sized to handle 250 qps peak for short text generation workloads (mostly 1-2k tokens) with a target 95th latency under 200ms.

We expect ~5M generated tokens/day in month 1 and a projected ramp to 25M/day over 6 months. Preference for H100-backed nodes if you recommend it for latency, but we can consider A100 if that improves cost predictability.

Can you share a sizing estimate, lead time, and whether you can guarantee region isolation (VPC + private routing)? Procurement will need a ballpark cost and PoC window next week.

Thanks —
Arya Sharma
Head of Platform, FinLytics
arya@finlytics.ai

Attachment: finlytics_capacity_requirements_v1.docx (requirements doc)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Arya Sharma <arya@finlytics.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: APAC dedicated pool need & timeline

Hi Arya — thanks for the detail and congrats on the contract close. Looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Vivek (capacity planning) to align on commercial sizing and timelines.

Initial thoughts:
- We can provision an APAC-dedicated pool that meets the 250 qps target. For 1–2k token workloads we typically recommend H100 for headroom; however A100 80GB quantized with aggressive batching + prefix caching could meet latency targets at roughly ~15–20% lower cost.
- Suggested starting config (PoC month): 8 H100 nodes (single-tenant pool), autoscale policy to +40% burst. That maps to ~200–300 qps sustained depending on batching.
- If you prefer cost-first, we can offer 12 A100 nodes with tuned batching; we’ll need to run a sample workload to validate 95th pct latency.

Next steps:
1) Marissa to confirm commercial preference (latency vs cost) so we can scope the committed capacity offer.
2) Vivek to surface lead-times for APAC infra (slot booking, partner drain) and propose start dates.
3) If procurement wants a PO, we can send a template and a preliminary SOW.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Arya Sharma <arya@finlytics.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: APAC dedicated pool need & timeline — initial sizing

Folks — ran a quick sim with the sample traces Arya shared. High-level results:
- H100 baseline: 8 x H100_80GB nodes -> ~270 qps sustained, 95th latency ~170ms with default batching and KV prefix cache. Headroom for burst up to ~380 qps with autoscale. Estimated token cost: $0.0019 per generated token (including networking).
- A100 alternative: 12 x A100_80GB -> ~260 qps sustained, 95th latency ~210ms unless we apply tighter batching heuristics; estimated token cost: $0.0016 per token.

Implications: H100 keeps us well under the 200ms 95th but costs ~20% more. A100 is cost-efficient but will need more ops tuning during PoC.

Proposed commercial packaging for the quote:
- PoC (30 days): 8 H100 nodes, limited commit, 10% PoC discount.
- Committed 12-mo: 8 H100 nodes reserved with 20% discount, monthly billing with quarterly usage true-up. Option to convert to a larger pool after month 3.

I can prepare a short deck with perf numbers and the model. Vivek — do you have availability to confirm APAC lead-times?

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Presales Engineer — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: APAC dedicated pool need & timeline — lead times & sloting

Team — quick operational note:
- APAC capacity provisioning (we manage both Redwood-hosted and partner cloudops installs) => lead time depends on GPU sourcing windows. With current supply we can reserve H100-backed capacity in APAC within ~4–6 weeks if we lock this week. If FinLytics accepts A100 we can compress to ~2–3 weeks via available partner inventory.
- Network/VPC isolation: we can deliver VPC-level isolation and dedicated routing; standard checklist includes MTR, BGP peering details, and customer KMS for keys.
- Suggested staging plan: 1) PoC slot (30 days) starting Mar 10, 2026; 2) production pool live by Apr 14, 2026. That assumes PO and SOW signed by Feb 20, 2026.

Operational caveats: autoscale burst relies on ephemeral shared capacity — for guaranteed burst we recommend a small buffer of reserved nodes (+2 H100).

Vivek

Head of Capacity & Operations — Redwood Inference
